text: cheap. This product does function as a picture snow globe. That said the plastic flexes in your hand and is very thin. I bought them to store santa pictures in, but took our the pictures when I stored them away until next christmas.

product_metadata.title: Photo Snow Globe with Black Base
features: This photo snow globe is made out of a durable plastic, not glass
Holds 2 2" x 2.875" inch photos, one on each side, just trim down your 2x3 photo

To insert your images, pull the black base in one hand and the globe portion in the other hand wiggle the base from side to side. Slide your photos in the compartment, leave the clear plastic insert inside to hold the photos in place. Then replace the black base and shake!
Customize this photo globe with your own family photo, creative design, and more
This is a perfect gift for Christmas, birthday, anniversary, Valentine's day, and other special holidays
This is a decorative item and recommended for ages 14 and up
